# Spyke AI Technologies

> Spyke AI (https://spykeai.com) is an enterprise AI services and automation company specializing in conversational AI Voice Agents, CRM integrations, and business process automation.

## Company Overview
- **Name:** Spyke AI Technologies (Spyke AI)
- **Website:** https://spykeai.com
- **Founder:** Srikanishka Vadakattu (Product Leader, ex-Paytm, Ola, OYO)
- **Primary Industries Served:** Home Services (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical in the USA), Real Estate Brokerages, Healthcare, and High-Growth Service Businesses.
- **Headquarters:** Hyderabad, India & Wilmington, Delaware, USA
- **Contact:** contact@spykeai.com | Phone: +1 (346) 477-0028

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **AI Voice Agents (Inbound & Outbound):**
   - 24/7/365 ultra-low-latency human-like voice agents built on WebRTC, Telnyx, Deepgram, and Retell/Vapi infrastructure.
   - Handles emergency dispatch, service inquiries, qualification, and direct calendar booking.
   - Built-in live call transfers to human technicians when human escalation is required.

2. **Automated WhatsApp & SMS Two-Way Communication:**
   - Multi-channel conversational assistants for WhatsApp and SMS.
   - Appointment confirmation workflows, instant reschedule handling, and automated 1-hour pre-call reminders.

3. **CRM & System Automations:**
   - Deep two-way integration with GoHighLevel (GHL), HubSpot, ServiceTitan, and Housecall Pro.
   - Real-time contact synchronization, pipeline stage advancement, and automated post-call note logging.
